body:
| Kind | Source | Persistence |
|---|---|---|
| `fsa` | Open Folder button (`showDirectoryPicker`) | handle in IDB → re-granted silently on reload |
| `fsa` via drop | **New:** drag-drop a folder; `DataTransferItem.getAsFileSystemHandle()` returns a persistent handle → treated like Open Folder | handle in IDB → re-granted on reload |
| `drop` (fallback) | Drag-drop without handle API (old Chrome / loose files) | snapshot content stored in IDB, no live refresh |
| `intercept` | `file://` URL opened in Chrome → content script rewrites → our tab loads it | sourceUrl fetched each view |
